tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail for one product by slug: description, pricing plans, features, segments and integration count. Use search_products first if you only have a name.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List or search Findstack software categories. Use this to turn a vague need into a category slug for search_products.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Findstack catalog for software products by keyword, category or capability. Returns name, slug, tagline, rating and review count for each match.

category.description: Category slug to restrict to, e.g. crm

free_plan.description: Only products offering a free plan
